description: A small play kitchen stove with hanging utensils is in front, with a metal pot on the right burner and a white bowl nearby. The right hand brings an egg over the pot and drops it in, then the left hand turns the right burner knob up; next the right hand lifts the hanging ladle/spoon, scoops the egg out of the pot, and transfers it into the white bowl before setting the pot aside while the left hand holds the bowl steady.
